title: Fresh seed 4 with its own mutation draws (mut_seed 4), T=10000: c58's 3-component kind-specific-waste vortices keep finding new trait classes (51 held by >=3 vs 17 in the kind-blind twin; 9 first-time dominants after t=3000 vs 2), and here old classes are also replaced faster (18% vs 36% of the classes active 1000 t earlier still present)
summary: c58's trait3d world (ew 0.25, sw 0.4, mut_dt 50) and its kind-blind twin (sw 0, same draws) on seed 4 with mut_seed 4, so the mutation directions are a new sequence (c58's seeds 1-3 all used mut_seed 1). Kind-specific: classes ever held by >= 3 vortices 10/18/27/51 at t=1500/3000/4500/10000; 13 distinct dominant classes, 9 first-time dominants after t=3000, 11 returns; classes reaching activity 5 per 1000 t: 11,8,7,6,8,8,12,3,5,6 (74 in all). Twin: 4/11/13/17; 4 dominant classes, 2 first-time dominants after t=3000; 8,4,8,2,5,4,5,1,2,2 (41). Diversity (mean pairwise trait distance) rises to 1.1 and stays against 0.45; centroid MSD at lag 1000 t 0.11 vs 0.008. The share of the classes active 1000 t earlier still present falls to ~0.18 late in the run against ~0.36 in the twin (on c58's seeds it was equal). Heredity holds in both arms: kinds change at mutations (125 trait jumps at a mutation, 2 elsewhere; twin 175 vs 1), and 104/126 daughters keep the parent's class (twin 456/514). The selective arm has fewer persistent splits (126 vs 514) and fewer, longer rods (maps).

finding.operator: kind-specific waste on a 3-component heritable trait
finding.control: kind-blind waste twin (sw 0, same mutation draws), fresh seed 4 and mut_seed 4, T=10000
finding.result: classes held by >=3: 51 vs 17; first-time dominants after t=3000: 9 vs 2; classes reaching activity 5: 74 vs 41; 1000-t class survival late ~0.18 vs ~0.36

limits: One more seed at one parameter point and 128^2, no dt/2 or grid test. trait3.py here is c58's with the thread count, grid size and world path made settable and vortex positions/track ids added to the output (this run used the earlier copy, so its JSON has no positions). The new classes have the same intrinsic fitness: they are new only relative to the waste (see 20261027T1800-c59-vortex-novelty-null for why the twin is the only meaningful baseline). The selective arm splits a quarter as often, so its generation depth (29) is lower than the twin's (51).
